headline: Nutrien Cancels Plans to Sell Phosphate Division and Will Close Florida Facility
summary: Nutrien reversed plans to sell its phosphate division, citing war in the Middle East, and announced it will instead shut down a facility in Florida during the second quarter of 2027.
why: Fertilizer producers must adapt capital allocation and operational footprints in response to volatile geopolitical conditions affecting global nutrient supply chains.

impacts.name: Nutrien Ltd
impacts.why: Canceling a major division sale and shuttering production facilities alters asset valuation and future cash flows.
